                                     Initialising                                     
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
nl and norg defined. nl= 25, norg=  0
Constant parcel velocity
Adiabatic Ascent
Interpolation ON
Logfile output is ON, output is written to logs
Precipitation formation through coalescence is OFF
ccn_conc_spectrum conversion [number/g of air]->[number/cm3] using model density
Switches checked OK
Rebinning will be performed using user-provided limits, read in from: 
inputs/rebin-midpoint_radii.dat and 
inputs/rebin-size_limits.dat
Rebinning data read in from files
Aerosol data from using user-provided data, read in from: 
inputs/custom-concentration.dat and 
inputs/custom-midpoint_radii.dat and 
inputs/custom-size_limits.dat and 
inputs/custom-composition.dat
